description: This file implements runtime decomposition registry and related functions for PyTorch JIT, including loading decomposition functions, registering decompositions, and executing them within the JIT compiler.

classes.name: JitDecomp
classes.description: Implements the JitDecompInterface for JIT decomposition handling.

methods.name: loadModule
methods.description: Loads decomposition functions into the compilation unit.

methods.name: loadDecompositionFunctions
methods.description: Loads and initializes decomposition functions if not already loaded.

methods.name: DecomposeOp
methods.description: Performs decomposition of a node if a decomposition exists.

methods.name: RunDecompositions
methods.description: Recursively runs decomposition on all nodes in a block.

methods.name: GetDecomposition
methods.description: Retrieves a decomposition graph for a given schema.

methods.name: GetDecompositionFunction
methods.description: Retrieves a GraphFunction for a given schema, setting execution mode to SIMPLE.

methods.name: RegisterDecomposition
methods.description: Registers a new decomposition graph for a schema.

methods.name: has_jit_decomposition
methods.description: Checks if a schema has a registered JIT decomposition.

methods.name: run_jit_decomposition
methods.description: Executes JIT decomposition for an operator.

methods.name: GetDecompositionExecutor
methods.description: Gets the executor (GraphFunction) for a schema.
